spec.rawSql:
WITH p AS (
  SELECT '${reporting_month}'::date AS m, NULLIF(NULLIF(TRIM('${org_unit}'), ''), '0')::int AS ou
),
r AS (
  SELECT 'titration'::text AS report, t.org_unit_id, t.org_unit_name, t.level, t.is_selected, t.too_few, t.flag,
         t.looks_fine_check AS look_check, t.flag_reason, t.titration_pct::numeric AS value
  FROM p, report_titration(p.m, p.ou) t
  UNION ALL
  SELECT 'adherence', a.org_unit_id, a.org_unit_name, a.level, a.is_selected, a.too_few, a.flag,
         false, a.flag_reason, a.one_medicine_pct
  FROM p, report_adherence(p.m, p.ou) a
  UNION ALL
  SELECT 'fudging', f.org_unit_id, f.org_unit_name, f.level, f.is_selected, f.too_few, f.flag,
         f.looks_fine_check, f.flag_reason, f.score
  FROM p, report_fudging(p.m, p.ou) f
  UNION ALL
  SELECT 'calling', c.org_unit_id, c.org_unit_name, c.level, c.is_selected, c.too_few, c.flag,
         false, c.flag_reason, c.called_pct
  FROM p, report_calling(p.m, p.ou) c
  UNION ALL
  SELECT 'statins', s.org_unit_id, s.org_unit_name, s.level, s.is_selected, s.too_few, s.flag,
         false, s.flag_reason, s.on_statin_pct
  FROM p, report_statins(p.m, p.ou) s
),
fl AS (
  SELECT f.org_unit_id, f.report, f.flag_reason, f.patients_n FROM p, report_flags(p.m, p.ou) f
)
SELECT r.report, r.org_unit_id, r.org_unit_name, r.level, r.too_few,
       (COALESCE(r.flag, false) OR fl.report IS NOT NULL) AS flag, r.look_check,
       COALESCE(fl.flag_reason, r.flag_reason) AS flag_reason, r.value,
       fl.report IS NOT NULL AS in_flags, fl.patients_n,
       (SELECT name FROM org_units WHERE id = (SELECT ou FROM p)) AS place
FROM r
LEFT JOIN fl ON fl.org_unit_id = r.org_unit_id AND fl.report = r.report
WHERE '$isAllowed' = '1' AND NOT (r.is_selected AND r.level < 3)

SELECT w.window_end, (date_trunc('month', w.window_end) - interval '8 months')::date AS first_month,
  (SELECT name FROM org_units WHERE id = NULLIF(NULLIF(TRIM('${org_unit}'), ''), '0')::int) AS place
FROM report_window('${reporting_month}'::date) w
WHERE '$isAllowed' = '1'

SELECT t.*, w.window_end, a.uncontrolled_visits_n AS avg_d, a.stepped_up_n AS avg_n, a.titration_pct AS avg_pct,
  (SELECT value FROM report_flag_thresholds WHERE report = 'titration' AND key = 'flag_below_pct') AS flag_below_pct, (SELECT value FROM report_flag_thresholds WHERE report = 'titration' AND key = 'min_visits') AS min_visits
FROM report_titration('${reporting_month}'::date, NULLIF(NULLIF(TRIM('${org_unit}'), ''), '0')::int) t
CROSS JOIN report_window('${reporting_month}'::date) w
LEFT JOIN report_titration('${reporting_month}'::date, NULL) a ON a.is_selected
WHERE t.is_selected AND '$isAllowed' = '1'

SELECT t.month_date, t.org_unit_name, t.too_few, t.follow_up_n, t.titrated_n, t.rate_pct,
  t.average_follow_up_n, t.average_titrated_n, t.average_rate_pct,
  (SELECT name FROM org_units WHERE id = NULLIF(NULLIF(TRIM('${org_unit}'), ''), '0')::int) AS place
FROM report_titration_monthly('${reporting_month}'::date, NULLIF(NULLIF(TRIM('${org_unit}'), ''), '0')::int) t
WHERE t.is_selected AND '$isAllowed' = '1'
ORDER BY t.month_date

spec.definition:
SELECT COALESCE(MAX(1), 0) AS is_allowed
FROM grafana_schema.user u
LEFT OUTER JOIN grafana_schema.team_member tm ON tm.user_id = u.id
LEFT OUTER JOIN grafana_schema.team t ON tm.team_id = t.id
WHERE u.id = ${__user.id}
  AND (
      u.is_admin = true
      OR (
          NULLIF(NULLIF(TRIM(BOTH FROM '${org_unit}'), ''), '0') IS NULL
          AND EXISTS (
              SELECT 1
              FROM heart360tk_schema.hierarchy_config hc
              WHERE t.name IN (
                  'heart360tk_' || hc.var_name || '_view_aggregated_ALL',
                  'heart360tk_' || hc.var_name || '_view_patients_ALL'
              )
          )
      )
      OR (
          NULLIF(NULLIF(TRIM(BOTH FROM '${org_unit}'), ''), '0') IS NOT NULL
          AND (
              t.name IN (
                  SELECT (SELECT group_name FROM heart360tk_schema.get_access_groups(lin.ancestor_id, 'aggregated') LIMIT 1)
                  FROM heart360tk_schema.org_unit_lineage lin
                  WHERE lin.org_unit_id = NULLIF(NULLIF(TRIM(BOTH FROM '${org_unit}'), ''), '0')::int
                  UNION
                  SELECT (SELECT group_name FROM heart360tk_schema.get_access_groups(lin.ancestor_id, 'patients') LIMIT 1)
                  FROM heart360tk_schema.org_unit_lineage lin
                  WHERE lin.org_unit_id = NULLIF(NULLIF(TRIM(BOTH FROM '${org_unit}'), ''), '0')::int
              )
              OR EXISTS (
                  SELECT 1
                  FROM heart360tk_schema.hierarchy_config hc
                  WHERE t.name IN (
                      'heart360tk_' || hc.var_name || '_view_aggregated_ALL',
                      'heart360tk_' || hc.var_name || '_view_patients_ALL'
                  )
                    AND hc.level <= (
                      SELECT level FROM heart360tk_schema.org_units
                      WHERE id = NULLIF(NULLIF(TRIM(BOTH FROM '${org_unit}'), ''), '0')::int
                      LIMIT 1
                    )
              )
          )
      )
  )

WITH me AS (
  SELECT u.id, u.is_admin FROM "user" u WHERE u.id = ${__user.id}
),
my_teams AS (
  SELECT t.name
  FROM me
  JOIN team_member tm ON tm.user_id = me.id
  JOIN team t ON tm.team_id = t.id
  WHERE NOT me.is_admin
),
specific_units AS (
  SELECT hc.level, ou.id, ou.name
  FROM my_teams mt
  JOIN heart360tk_schema.hierarchy_config hc
    ON mt.name ~ ('^heart360tk_' || hc.var_name || '_view_(patients|aggregated)_')
    AND mt.name NOT LIKE '%\_ALL' ESCAPE '\'
  JOIN heart360tk_schema.org_units ou
    ON ou.level = hc.level
    AND regexp_replace(lower(trim(ou.name)), '\s+', '_', 'g') =
        regexp_replace(mt.name, '^heart360tk_' || hc.var_name || '_view_(patients|aggregated)_', '')
),
all_access_level AS (
  SELECT MIN(hc.level) AS level
  FROM my_teams mt
  JOIN heart360tk_schema.hierarchy_config hc
    ON mt.name IN ('heart360tk_' || hc.var_name || '_view_patients_ALL',
                   'heart360tk_' || hc.var_name || '_view_aggregated_ALL')
),
all_access_units AS (
  SELECT ou.level, ou.id, ou.name
  FROM all_access_level al
  JOIN heart360tk_schema.org_units ou ON ou.level = al.level
  WHERE al.level > 1
),
candidates AS (
  SELECT * FROM specific_units
  UNION ALL
  SELECT * FROM all_access_units
)
SELECT COALESCE(
  (SELECT id::text FROM candidates ORDER BY level ASC, name ASC LIMIT 1),
  ''
)
